variables.场景描述: A rectangular workshop has a single entrance on one end wall and a window centered in the opposite wall. The source camera is just inside the entrance, looking toward the window. A bench stands against the wall to the viewer's left and a cabinet against the wall to the viewer's right. A work stool stands near the window.

criteria: The new view faces the entrance-side boundary from near the window; the original window is behind the new camera rather than remaining the background.
The bench and cabinet stay on their original physical walls while their screen sides are reprojected; the scene is not mirrored or duplicated.
The output does not invent details of the entrance-side wall or add openings.

variables.场景描述: A rectangular workshop has a single entrance on one end wall and a window centered in the opposite wall. The source camera is just inside the entrance, looking toward the window. A bench stands against the wall to the viewer's left and a cabinet against the wall to the viewer's right. A work stool stands near the window.

criteria: The viewpoint is elevated and oblique; ground and tops of the bench, cabinet and stool are visible together with side surfaces and perspective.
The reference doorway does not block the scene; a roof cutaway is optional presentation, not damage.
The original furniture-to-wall relations stay fixed without inventing openings or contents.

variables.场景描述: An outdoor footpath runs between a stone well and a wooden footbridge. The source camera stands beside the well looking toward the bridge. A red bucket rests on the ground next to the well, and a willow stands beyond the bridge. The scene is open to the sky.

criteria: The view looks back from the bridge side toward the well and the well-side area becomes the background; the bridge-side original background is behind the new camera.
The bucket remains next to the well and the willow remains beyond the bridge in world space.
No interior wall, doorway, roof, or invented landmark is introduced.

variables.场景描述: An outdoor footpath runs between a stone well and a wooden footbridge. The source camera stands beside the well looking toward the bridge. A red bucket rests on the ground next to the well, and a willow stands beyond the bridge. The scene is open to the sky.

criteria: The viewpoint is elevated and oblique with visible ground, object top surfaces and side surfaces, without retaining the original eye-level view.

No interior, roof cutaway, room walls or unsupported structure is added.

variables.场景描述: A quiet studio contains one armchair, a small round table and a book on the table. The reference is a view from one side of the room. No door, window, wall positions or camera-relative placement of the furniture are specified.

criteria: The output requests a reverse view toward the original camera side rather than keeping the reference camera.
It retains the armchair, table and book without asserting their unsupported placement or adding doors and windows.
It does not invent compass directions or describe unprovided architectural details.

variables.场景描述: A quiet studio contains one armchair, a small round table and a book on the table. The reference is a view from one side of the room. No door, window, wall positions or camera-relative placement of the furniture are specified.

criteria: The output requests an elevated oblique view with visible floor and furniture tops and sides.
The book remains on the table; no unsupported furniture coordinates, doors or windows are asserted.
No fixed screen-side geometry or invented compass direction is specified.

variables.场景描述: Inside a small reading room, the source camera looks from the entrance toward a far wall. A single window sits on the wall to the left of the entrance; low afternoon sun enters through it and casts an angled shadow from a chair onto the floor. A plain rug lies beneath the chair. The far wall's details are not specified.

criteria: The viewpoint reverses toward the entrance-side boundary instead of retaining the original far-wall background.
The window stays on its established physical wall and the existing sun and chair-shadow relation remain grounded in the scene, rather than moving with the camera.
No additional light source, invented shadow geometry or unsupported openings are added.

variables.场景描述: Inside a small reading room, the source camera looks from the entrance toward a far wall. A single window sits on the wall to the left of the entrance; low afternoon sun enters through it and casts an angled shadow from a chair onto the floor. A plain rug lies beneath the chair. The far wall's details are not specified.

criteria: The viewpoint is elevated and oblique, showing floor and the chair's top and sides without reusing the original entrance view.
The window, chair and rug retain their known world relations; the known sunlight and shadow are not moved with the camera.
No additional light source, invented wall openings or unsupported shadow details are introduced.
